text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A for a gain felt satisfying, but trimming winners without a broader plan did not protect my account from later declines; I should set clear position and exit rules.","I made no trades as my account continued to fall, perhaps because admitting a mistake and realizing a loss feels painful; I should review each holding objectively rather than let my purchase price dictate decisions.","Checking my account often can amplify fear and prompt reactive choices; I should focus on my longer-term plan and diversified risk instead of every month's fluctuation."]}
